title: Land purchase for new Upcountry well at Haleakalā Ranch
summary: On June 19, a department representative asked the council to act on Resolution 26-102, a $470,000 land purchase for a new upcountry well. The chair asked him to return when the item comes up, and a council member asked that the department director or deputy attend; staff said they could arrange it. He said the well would add one million gallons a day and, with filter upgrades at a treatment plant, let the county resume processing the upcountry wait list.

timeline.text: A council member asked for the department director or deputy to attend when the item is taken up, and a staff member said they could get them there.
The chair asked the representative to come back when the item comes up.
The representative said the well, together with filter upgrades at a water treatment plant, would let the county resume processing the upcountry wait list.
He said the well would add one million gallons a day to the upcountry water system.
The representative said the land price is $470,000.
He said the purchase followed the standard process, including an independent appraisal (an outside estimate of the land's value).
A department representative asked the council to act today on Resolution 26-102, a land purchase for a new upcountry well.
